description: Copy one file from the LOCAL project directory to the remote workspace (up to 64 MiB). Replaces an existing remote file. Secrets and project state (.git, .claude, .env*, keys, .mirafleet.yaml) are never transferred. On a guarded fleet you must first ask the user and get their explicit agreement; only then set `confirm` to the fleet name.

confirm.description: Guarded fleets only: the fleet name, set only after the user explicitly agreed. Never set it on your own.

context.description: Context name. Omit to use the default.

fleet.description: Fleet name. Omit to use the default.

local.description: Local file, relative to the local project directory (or absolute inside it). Secrets and project state (.git, .env*, keys, .mirafleet.yaml) are refused.

mode.description: Permission bits (decimal). Default: keep the executable bit.

remote.description: Destination on the remote machine. Default: the same relative path as local.

workspace.description: Workspace id. Omit to use this session's workspace on the fleet.

name: upload
